summary: Executive Order 22 rescinds Executive Order No. 30 (January 18, 2024) and Executive Directive No. 5 (September 20, 2023), both issued by Governor Glenn Youngkin. The policies, standards and guidelines published pursuant to Executive Order No. 30 remain in effect unless or until replaced through a future executive or agency action.
text: This Executive Order rescinds Executive Order No. 30 (Jan. 18, 2024) and Executive Directive No. 5 (Sept. 20, 2023) issued by Governor Glenn Youngkin. The policies, standards, and guidelines published pursuant to Executive Order No. 30 shall remain in effect unless or until replaced through a future executive or agency action.

source.citation: Virginia Executive Order 22 (2026), Establishing New Nation-Leading Standards and Initiatives to Implement the Virginia Data Center Accountability Framework and Responding to Unprecedented Risk from Artificial Intelligence, signed September 18 2026

notes: Supersession event. Any corpus entry resting on Virginia EO 30 or ED 5 requires review. Note the split: the orders are rescinded, their published outputs survive until replaced. The instrument and its products have different status.
confidence_note: The content of Executive Order 30 and Executive Directive 5 has not been read, and this entry does not establish what those instruments contained or which published policies survive. No corpus entry has yet been checked against this rescission.
